body.requirement_digest: SHA-256 over RFC 8785 canonical requirement bytes
body.requirement_binding: The requirement digest MUST be covered by the supported target decision's resource_attributes_canonical_hash.

verdicts.supported: the signed requirement threshold is satisfied by distinct eligible supported v2 claims
verdicts.disproved: present evidence contradicts the signed requirement or a counted claim
verdicts.insufficient_evidence: signed requirement coverage, signer expansion, target decision, or enough supported members is missing
verdicts.unverifiable_scope: requirement or identity-expansion semantics are unsupported
